About Pearl Lemon
Your SEO partner for long-term business growth
BOOK YOUR 15-MINUTE STRATEGY CALL
Who We Are
Specialists in building visibility and organic growth
Pearl Lemon is an
SEO agency based in London
with a distributed global team. Founded by
Deepak Shukla in 2016
, we began as a consultancy and have since grown into an established SEO agency with publicly available client feedback. With
1,000+ group-wide online reviews (self-reported; all ratings)
across Google,
Clutch
, Trustpilot, and more, we’re trusted by startups, scale-ups, and global brands.
We focus on SEO because we know that organic rankings can support relevant traffic and enquiries, though search visibility alone does not guarantee revenue.
Book a Strategy Call
Our Mission
To deliver measurable SEO growth for every client
Our mission is straightforward: help businesses increase organic traffic, keyword rankings, and inbound leads through proven SEO strategies. Every campaign is built on three principles: structure, consistency, and execution.
Our Vision
To set the global standard for SEO agencies
We aim to be recognised as the world’s leading SEO partner, known not only for technical expertise, but also for our commitment to accountability, transparency, and long-term client success.
Our Story
From a one-person consultancy to a global SEO team
In 2016, Deepak Shukla started Pearl Lemon as a solo SEO consultant, working out of cafés across London. His vision was to build an agency where results and accountability came before buzzwords.
Today, Pearl Lemon has grown into a
team of 130+ SEO specialists across four continents
, delivering campaigns for clients in
SaaS, healthcare, finance, eCommerce, and professional services
.
The full version of how we got here is in
our story
.
Our Services
SEO solutions that cover every ranking factor
At Pearl Lemon, we provide the full range of SEO services to help businesses succeed online:
Local SEO
– Rank for location-based searches and win more local customers.
SEO Audits
– Identify technical issues, content gaps, and growth opportunities.
WordPress SEO
– Advanced optimisation for one of the world’s most popular CMS platforms.
E-Commerce SEO
– Increase visibility for products, categories, and online stores.
Technical SEO
– Fix crawl, indexing, and site structure challenges holding back rankings.
International SEO
– Expand into multilingual and multi-regional search markets.

Meet Our Leadership
Entrepreneurial leadership with SEO expertise
At Pearl Lemon, our leadership team brings together entrepreneurial zeal, years of SEO experience, and hands-on expertise across every core area of search. Each leader plays an active role in shaping strategy and guiding client campaigns. You can also
meet the wider team
of specialists working behind every campaign.
Deepak Shukla – Founder & CEO
Deepak Shukla
founded Pearl Lemon in 2016 with a simple vision: build an SEO agency that prioritises accountability, transparency, and measurable outcomes over empty promises.
A former
Deloitte consultant
,
Ironman athlete
, and
TEDx speaker
, Deepak has grown Pearl Lemon from a one-person consultancy into a
global SEO agency with public reviews and case studies
and clients spanning SaaS, healthcare, finance, eCommerce, and professional services.
Beyond running the agency, Deepak has been featured in
Forbes, BBC, Deloitte, SEMrush, and Search Engine Journal
for his insights into SEO and business growth. He also hosts training sessions, podcasts, and talks where he shares lessons learned from building both Pearl Lemon and other ventures within the group.
Ali Ubaid – Head of SEO
With nearly two decades of SEO experience, Ali leads Pearl Lemon’s SEO division as our
Head of SEO
. He has successfully managed hundreds of campaigns across industries ranging from startups to large enterprises.
Ali specialises in:
Technical SEO
– Identifying and resolving crawl, indexing, and site architecture issues.
Algorithm analysis
– Staying ahead of search engine changes to protect and grow client rankings.
Scalable SEO strategies
– Developing processes that produce long-term visibility and growth.
Under his leadership, Pearl Lemon consistently delivers campaigns that secure
page 1 rankings, traffic growth, and qualified leads
.
Ismail Abubakar – Head of External SEO
Ismail is an expert in
SEO audits, backlink acquisition, and conversion-focused optimisation
. With over seven years of hands-on experience, he has helped clients achieve up to
200% traffic growth
while generating more than
8.4 million impressions
for their websites.
His strengths include:
Conducting
SEO audits
to identify quick wins and long-term fixes.
Designing
link building campaigns
that improve domain authority and keyword rankings.
Combining SEO with
conversion strategies
, ensuring traffic translates into leads and revenue.
Ismail’s clear communication and results-focused approach have made him a trusted SEO partner for businesses across industries.

FAQs
What makes Pearl Lemon different from other SEO agencies?
We publish selected campaign case studies and link to independent reviews so buyers can inspect the project scope, dates and limitations. Past results, including lead and traffic metrics, should not be read as promises for a future campaign.
How long does SEO take to deliver results?
Most clients begin to see measurable improvements in rankings and traffic within 3–4 months, but SEO is an ongoing process designed for long-term stability.
Do you work with small businesses or only large companies?
Both. We partner with startups, SMEs, and global enterprises, cutomising SEO strategies to the size, budget, and growth goals of each client.
What industries does Pearl Lemon specialise in?
We have delivered successful SEO campaigns in SaaS, healthcare, finance, law, real estate, eCommerce, and professional services.
Do you provide SEO audits?
Yes. Our audits identify technical issues, content gaps, backlink opportunities, and site structure improvements — giving you a clear roadmap for SEO success.
Can you help with international SEO?
Absolutely. We manage multi-language and multi-region SEO campaigns, ensuring your site ranks globally while staying relevant in local markets.
How do you measure SEO success?
We track keyword rankings, organic traffic growth, conversion rates, and lead volume. Clients receive clear weekly reports and regular strategy calls.
What’s included in your SEO services?
Our services cover the full spectrum of search optimisation: Local SEO, Technical SEO, WordPress SEO, E-Commerce SEO, International SEO, and SEO audits.
Do you guarantee Page 1 rankings?
No credible agency can promise specific rankings, as search algorithms are constantly evolving. What we do guarantee is transparent reporting, consistent execution, and long-term performance improvements.
How do I get started with Pearl Lemon?
You can begin with a free SEO audit or book a call with our team. From there, we’ll review your site, goals, and challenges, then recommend the best path forward.
